# S354 — Accept relay v12

*Proposed.* ork accepts relay v11 and v12 (adj 324, `boundary.contract-set`, supersedes adj 175) and its role prompts move to v12. v12 adds one thing: tool feedback. ork builds it in full (adj 325, `relay.tool-feedback`).

**Findings:** 2026-11-12: slicer 1.21.0 (s453) prints `Contract: relay v12`; `ork doctor` reports "[FAIL] contract  ork accepts relay v10 or v11 and slicer prints v12" for every project, and a new ork run refuses to start. · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

## Why

*Proposed.* slicer's `RELAY_CHANGES` entry for 12 (`slicer ai relay --json`, `changes[]`, last entry): every role, the read-only ones included, may end its report with up to 3 tool feedback lines about slicer or another tool, kind `friction`, `feature` or `deterministic-check`. The orchestrator carries them into its run report, each prefixed with the role, at most 3 in all, as `tool feedback: N. ROLE | tool: slicer|ork|NAME | kind: ... | proposal: TEXT | evidence: TEXT` (`tool feedback: none` when empty); `--json` gains `tool_feedback` after `conformance`. Tool feedback is advisory: it is not a finding, the gate never decides on it, and no role changes code, files an item or runs `slicer feedback` in the slice because of it. No secret goes in `evidence`. The conformance keys and `roles[]` are the same as v11.

Owner decisions (2026-11-12, interactive question, relay session 8d711f67): accept v11 and v12, drop v10 (adj 324); build tool feedback in full: prompts allow it, ork parses it from role reports and records it in the run, at most 3, advisory (adj 325). Showing it in the TUI or `ork show` is not in this slice.

## Failing tests

- `CheckContractLine("Contract: relay v12")` returns 12 with no error; v10 and v13 are refused and the message names {11, 12}.
- `RelayContract.Validate` accepts the recorded v12 JSON and the recorded v11 JSON.
- Each prompt's first line equals `relay v12`, and each prompt allows up to 3 tool feedback lines and says they are advisory.
- `CheckReport` on a reviewer report with 2 well-formed tool feedback lines returns both with their role, kind, tool, proposal and evidence; a 4th line and a malformed line are dropped without a shape error; a report with none passes as before.
- A run whose roles report 5 tool feedback lines in all keeps 3 in its record, in report order.
- A gate's tool feedback never changes its verdict or the findings.
- Engine start with a fake slicer printing v12 creates a run; v10 is refused naming {11, 12}.
